Insilico Medicine has made significant strides with its AI-designed drug, rentosertib, which shows potential in reversing biological aging. In a trial, patients demonstrated improved lung function and reduced biological age by up to six years according to six independent aging clocks. 🌍💊 

What could this mean for future treatments?
